newarticles-desc: Description of the WRNewArticles extension, shown on Special:Version.
newarticles: Title of the special page listing new articles.
newarticles-articletype: Article type label shown in parentheses next to an article. $1 is the article type name.
newarticles-original-title: Label showing the original title of an article before it was renamed. $1 is the original title.
newarticles-filter-contentarea: Label for the content area filter on the new articles special page.
